Admin Portal — Session Auth
item.description: OTP-based email auth for the internal admin portal. These endpoints set/clear the httpOnly ptk_admin_session cookie. Run 41→42 in sequence; copy the 6-digit code from your inbox (or server stdout if RESEND_API_KEY is not set).

request.description: Replace 123456 with the real code from email / server logs. On success: sets httpOnly ptk_admin_session cookie (valid 24h). Postman stores cookies automatically.
Returns the logged-in admin email. Requires ptk_admin_session cookie — Postman sends it automatically if set.
Revokes the session token in the DB and clears the cookie.
